provenance: archive: sandy_hackett_v2_red_v4 (the crown completion, 2026-09-11) — measured 2026-09-19 with OpenCV 5 in-repo (python3 -m stage_ready measure sandy) from work/midtown_sandy_hackett_v2: separation 1.72× (silhouette_qc.py over comp/), matte_qc 98 %, head spread 2.9 % and drift 5.3 px from affine.csv + matte_ext (track.log: 8.9 % of source → 2.9 % of output), 1436 frames + audio MD5 on the encode.
